name: Tumeken's shadow: charged with ::shadow, Check, wield, its own spell fights a castle man from one Attack click with charges and no runes, then taken off and uncharged for the runes back

steps.comment: a new account's stats, nothing worn or carried, no charges; ::reset at the end puts the account back
game messages show their keys, whatever data/dialogue.txt holds
the shadow needs 85 Magic, and its spell's max hit is Magic / 3 + 1
charging with Charge or runes used on it asks for a count, which the runner can't type yet; the headless test covers it
the courtyard, where the other magic scripts' casts land
the powered staff's first style casts its own spell, with no autocast picked
tumekens_shadow_impact if it hit, failedspell_impact if it splashed
a man has 7 hitpoints and the spell's max hit is 34 here, so the fight is over or nearly; ::kill isn't used, as it would fail on his corpse
99 or fewer: a charge a cast; a key, as ::keys is on
worn Check is in the headless test: the real client doesn't show members' worn ops here yet (the blowpipe's either)
2 soul runes and 5 chaos runes a charge left
the uncharged shadow, where the charged one was
